title: Borderline Continuity of Conformal Metric Parametrizations
statement: For a simply connected surface $V$ equal to $\mathbb{R}^2$ or $S^2$, does the parametrization $(u,\phi)\mapsto\phi^*e^{-2u}g_\kappa$ remain a homeomorphism in the borderline $C^{r,0}$ metric, function, and diffeomorphism topologies?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Mini-Workshop: Spaces and Moduli Spaces of Riemannian Metrics (2018), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2017/3, pp. 133--166](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2017/3)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** partially solved

**Assessment.** The decomposition map is proved to be a homeomorphism in the stated C^{r,\alpha} settings with 0<\alpha<1, while the borderline alpha=0 topology is explicitly left unresolved and expected to fail.

**Sources checked.**

- [Oberwolfach report on nonnegative surfaces](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2017/3)
- [Banakh--Belegradek spaces of nonnegatively curved surfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/1510.07269)
